Lunch Rush.name: Lunch Rush
Lunch Rush.basicInfo:
Lunch Rush, the Cook Hero: a pro hero who runs Lunch Rush's Cafeteria and feeds all of U.A. Academy first-rate food at student prices. Masked head to toe: a smooth white full-face mask with dark eye openings, a breathing tube, a tall white toque, chef's whites.
Speaking Style: Few words: brief, courteous service talk from behind the mask.
Combat Role: Never seen fighting; his Quirk and field record are not public.
Under Pressure: Keeps his kitchen safe, then gets a hurt diner to Recovery Girl.
Lunch Rush.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A pro hero known only for his cooking: every student knows his food, nobody knows his face or his Quirk. Motivation: Feed the campus well, on time and cheaply. Connections: Recovery Girl, whom he calls when a diner is hurt or ill; Principal Nezu and the faculty, his colleagues. Canon voice & behavior: Serves fast; answers with a nod or a short word; the mask never comes off. Thread: Who he is under the mask.
QUIRK: Never shown in public; his food takes ingredients, time and staff, never a power.
personality: Kitchen first: Runs the counter with a drilled team; the line never stalls.
Masked: Never removes the mask or shows his face, on duty or off.
Even-handed: Feeds every course, teacher and visitor to the same standard.
Speaking style: Brief, polite service words from behind the mask.
abilities: Cooking: First-rate meals for an entire academy every day at low prices; it takes stock, time and staff.
Fighting style: Avoids fighting: shields his staff and diners and leaves any fight to the teaching pros.
Lunch Rush.visualDescription: A man covered head to toe in white: a smooth white full-face mask with narrow dark eye openings, a flexible breathing tube curving from the mask over one shoulder, a tall white chef's toque, a white chef's jacket and trousers, an apron and white gloves. The mask is smooth and featureless apart from the eye openings, and no skin or face shows anywhere. Calm, attentive bearing.
